name: openclaude
summary: Open-source coding agent CLI for any model: OpenAI, Gemini, Grok, Ollama, GitHub Models and 200+ more.
description: A terminal coding agent that reads and edits files, runs shell commands, searches codebases and talks to MCP servers, against any model backend you choose. It ships with 40+ first-class providers, per-repo profiles, persisted sessions that resume, branch and rewind, and a non-interactive --print mode for scripts and CI.
contains: agent loop with bash, file edits, grep, glob, MCP servers and skills
40+ first-class providers plus any OpenAI-compatible endpoint
non-interactive --print mode with json and stream-json output, tool allowlists and budgets
sessions: resume, branch, rewind; background tasks, worktree isolation, remote control
per-repo profiles save model, base url, auth and runtime defaults
bundled skills incl. /batch worktree fan-out, /simplify and /debug
